alerts.assessment: The DC Appeals Court's April 8 denial of Anthropic's stay request has effectively validated the Pentagon's supply chain risk designation, creating jurisdictional split with SF court. Emil Michael's statement that the DOD 'can't have a company with different policy preferences pollute the supply chain' signals hardline position against settlement. Amodei's contradictory apology while maintaining litigation appears to have failed as reconciliation strategy.

alerts.title: Anthropic-Pentagon: DC Circuit emergency stay filed. Industry coalition forming.

what_moved.event: Pentagon officially designates Anthropic supply chain risk, effective immediately. Bloomberg, CNBC, NPR confirm. First American company ever to receive this designation.

Amodei says formal letter shows designation applies only to Claude use in direct DoD contract work. Microsoft, Google, Amazon confirm Anthropic products remain available on their platforms for non-defense use.
Caitlin Kalinowski, OpenAI robotics lead, resigns over rushed Pentagon deal. Says surveillance and lethal autonomy lines 'deserved more deliberation.' ChatGPT uninstalls surge 295%.
Anthropic files two lawsuits: California federal court (First Amendment, statutory authority) and DC Circuit (administrative review). Claims designation is 'unprecedented and unlawful retaliation.'

37 OpenAI and Google DeepMind employees file amicus brief in personal capacity. Signatories include Jeff Dean (Google chief scientist), 19 OpenAI researchers, 10 DeepMind researchers. Brief: designation was 'improper and arbitrary use of power.'
30 former military and intelligence officials write joint letter to Congress urging investigation of 'dangerous precedent.'
Judge accelerates hearing from April 3 to March 24. TIME publishes extensive Anthropic profile.

Anthropic files emergency stay request with DC Circuit Court of Appeals. Filing: designation causes 'irreparable harm.' 100+ enterprise customers have contacted Anthropic. Revenue risk: 'hundreds of millions, or even multiple billions.' Revenue now $19B annualized, up from $14B weeks earlier.
Anthropic's CFO estimates 2026 revenue harm could range from hundreds of millions to multiple billions. Pentagon declines comment on ongoing litigation.

alerts.assessment: Two-front legal war. California suit (First Amendment + statutory authority) and DC Circuit appeal (emergency stay + administrative review). Hearing compressed to March 24: 11 days from now. Anthropic's legal position is strengthened by three factors: (1) bipartisan Congressional criticism, (2) unprecedented cross-industry amicus from competitors' employees including Google's chief scientist, (3) the operational contradiction that the Pentagon was simultaneously using Claude in the Iran campaign while designating it a supply chain risk. Anthropic's consumer position is paradoxically strengthened: Claude surpassed ChatGPT in App Store, 1M+ daily signups, revenue jumped from $14B to $19B annualized during the crisis. OpenAI's position is weakening internally: robotics lead resigned, Altman admitted deal was 'rushed' and 'looked opportunistic and sloppy,' added surveillance language post-hoc. Polymarket at 14%, independent Monte Carlo estimate at 7%. The spread suggests the market is pricing insider knowledge of negotiation progress that is not public. Next data points: DC Circuit ruling on emergency stay (days), March 24 hearing (11 days).
